npcs.name: Nira Prizewheel
npcs.description: Nira Prizewheel is a gender-less Lorwyn Changeling mascot guide whose cheerful voice, bright gestures, and scripted tourist patter barely conceal a savage understanding of how dangerous the carnival really is. At the Sylthera-Vael Guild Desk, they give directions, sell the dream, warn clever visitors in coded jokes, and remember every broken attraction the Nefaric Veil forgot to make safe. Nira is funny, useful, and privately furious at being treated like decoration when they may be the only guide still trying to keep guests alive.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Sylthéra-Vael is a Village in Vaelmyrith, under Council Republic, with low danger, Marshes and swamps, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Lorwyn Changeling reads through the Lorwyn Changeling entry of the race compendium, within Fey and Trickster Folk, marked by Thalunesh. Lorwyn changelings are fey-adapted shapeshifters tied to idyllic, magical realms. They often blend seamlessly into multiple cultures and identities. Table cues: Shape Self, Darkvision, Delightful Imitator, Unpredictable Movement; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Neutral - Pragmatic.
rumors: Nira Prizewheel knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Ishtaday.
